I feel like they TRIED to make something cool, and while I put it as recommended, I wouldn't say the same if it was paid. Animations are janky, loading screens get stuck, and there was a strange jittering with the camera when I moved. It does look really nice, but gameplay is more important than graphics in my opinion. EDIT(after beating the game): Most of my prior comments stay the same, and after beating the game, I can confidently say it IS pretty fun to play with friends, just because it's so fricking silly to look at. I wouldn't call it scary, though, so if that's what you're looking for, keep moving.

我從未了解過後室系列題材，此遊戲將光怪陸離的後室世界向我予以具象化，令我深受後室題材的內容吸引。儘管遊戲中的層級較少，內容里仍有不少彩蛋或細節，可見作者的用心。 以下為我遊玩時遇到問題，并認為可能改進的地方： 1.聯機模式，角色生成的時候無法立即開始遊戲(進入40秒倒計時)，倒計時結束後實體直接出現在玩家生成點，致使我和朋友集體死亡。 2.有很大部分彩蛋未完成，例如level fun後面那關的失真鑰匙和失真房間(我不知道描述得是否易懂)，鑰匙撿起後到失真房間門口依然提示需要鑰匙，合理推測應該是未完成的彩蛋。 3.我聽朋友說後室的層級不是線性路徑的，比如level 5說是可以返回level 2的，遊戲里并沒有做這部分，我作為一個玩家挺期待的，這很有趣。 感謝閱讀！

This game is not much of an upgrade to the original Backrooms Deluxe, if at all. There are very few things that this game actually improves on, and in many ways it changes the levels for the worse. I honestly do not see why this is a separate game from the original, although I am glad that the original game wasn't updated to be like this one, as I do think the original is better. There are many bugs that try to stop you from playing the game. Sometimes I'd get stuck on the photosensitivity warning, preventing me from being able to progress. If you encounter any of these bugs, you have to close the game and reopen it. If you die and click to retry, you would get softlocked on a black screen. Sometimes choosing to play solo will just softlock you on the server screen and you would have to close the game again. I see people complaining that multiplayer is broken. I lost count of how many times I had to close and reopen the game just because without thinking I clicked to retry. Also why on earth if you beat the game on multiplayer (which i played because apparently singleplayer is missing some features) can I not access a specific level on singleplayer? If I wanted to be able to play singleplayer from any level I would have to replay through the entire game again to unlock every level! According to the menu page, the level unlocks are based on the achievements for entering each level, so it really would not be that difficult to make the singleplayer menu check if you have the achievements. Level 0 is fine, the addition of seeing a snapshot of the Habitable Zone in the exit is nice. However, removing the exit to Where I Call Home does not make much sense to me. The level itself looked nice and it was cool to see multiple exits to a level. The changing of some of the models so they were no longer the same as Escape The Backrooms was nice, and I really like the new skinstealer model. It looks horrifying and is a nice change from the 'normal' model. Changing the Poolrooms exit also did not make much sense to me either. Climbing the diving board was interesting, if a bit buggy, and the noclip was quite cool. Now there is just a pitch black wall that mysteriously vanishes when you turn enough valves, which leads to yet another door. Removing the key code from the Abandoned Office and turning it into yet another door that you open with another key makes it blend in with all the other levels with just another key and another door. I understand the original game was similar to this, but this game is rebranded as a sequel when it really isn't. The game also features many bugs. In Roads to Abyss, I still thought that a partygoer would spawn and take me to Level Fun. I completely missed the balloon, and reached the end of the map. I thought that maybe jumping into the void would take me the next level, but all it made me do was have to restart the entire level. This is an issue with a lot of the levels where if I did not play the original game, I would not know what to do. I spent about 10 minutes in Kitty's House, interacting with everything before I finally realised I had to interact with the bed to progress. There are no clues to tell you this. The bed does not glow, there aren't any notes. You should just naturally realise to interact with the bed. In The Windows, there is a 'suspicious' door. It tells you that you need a key. I found a key somewhere else in the level. I interact with the door. It tells me I need a key. I go back and make sure that I did pick up the key. I did pick up the key. I interact with the door again. It tells me I need a key. You do not need to go through the door to beat the level, but what is the point of adding a key if it doesn't work? And Grassy Hills. My least favourite level. I must have spent at least 2.5 hours of my nearly 5 hours trying to figure out how to beat this level. In the original, you must light a few candles. In this one, I wander around the houses. In the 3 open houses, I find nothing to help me beat the level. One house had a window with a weird texture that made it look like it was frozen. I thought maybe that would send me to the next level. Nothing. I wander around for ages. I die to sanity multiple times to see if there would be a tip on the death screen. Nothing. I finally find an open house at the end of the road. I just think 'finally' and that it is a bit stupid of me to not follow the obvious road. Its just a small garage with 3 almond water. Nothing else. I continue wandering around for ages. I explore the whole map. I finally give up and try to cheat my way through it. I try to set up FModel to be able to see the blueprints for the level. I give up. I install Steam Achievements Manager to see if I can just give myself the achievement for the next level to be able to access it. It's locked. I was about to post in the community to ask for how to beat the level when I see that the dev had responded on someone's post asking a similar thing, saying that the WIDE DUCK OF ALL THINGS in one of the houses launched you and you could access the floating house like that. There was nothing to show that. I noticed that the duck did not despawn. I noticed you could pick it up again. But why would I try walking into it? Again, there are no hints for the duck. In fact, sometimes when I spawned it it would just vanish into the void, never to be seen again. This level was the bane of my time playing the game. I wanted to finish it, just so I could make a fair review but honestly, who thinks of walking into the wide duck? And some of the achievments seem broken. I replayed the game from level 0 to get the jump. I do it in exploration mode as I do not want to try to get to The Windows without dying. I go to the hill on Roads to Abyss. Nothing. No achievement. I spend about 3 minutes jumping around it before I give up. I finally reach The Windows, and jump to my death. No achievement. Maybe you have to do it legitimately with no exploration modifier, but then say that somewhere in the achievements! Overall, this game is a downgrade to the original due to removing things or changing things for the worse just to say that they were changed, and I am glad that I got the original before it became unavailable to add to your library. I would recommend the original game, but if have not already added it to your steam library you can't anymore.

Honestly, I really liked the game, and it's really cool for a free game. I completed it fully and unlocked over 85% of the offline achievements. I’ll also say that the creatures in this game can be really annoying and move slowly (I understand that for free we’re not getting a true masterpiece), especially the Skinwalker. On level 5 or in the sewers, when you’re either heading to a picture or behind a wall, the Skinwalker suddenly rushes out from a corner and kills you, and if you manage to react in any way, your character can barely drag their feet in the opposite direction. It feels like when replaying the game, it just stands there the whole level waiting for you, so it’s better to approach the corner slowly or wait until the Skinwalker comes out and sees you, then chase you—this way it’ll be under your control. I wish the creatures were a bit more active and faster, and I’d like a bit more optimization for weaker PCs like mine.
